Photographic surroundings for PlanToTour Studio

Put a 360 degree photo (equirectangular) here as sky.hdr (best) or sky.jpg, and the Studio uses it
as the backdrop and light in daylight. Free, public-domain (CC0) photos: https://polyhaven.com/hdris
(download the 2K .hdr). Good choices for apartments: an urban square or street, a park, a terrace
with a view. Without a file here the Studio tries a Poly Haven city photo, then falls back to its
own sky.
